seoTitle: Skip Link Generator: Skip to Main Content HTML and CSS
metaDescription: Create a skip to main content link whose CSS stays hidden until keyboard focus, with colours checked for contrast and the main element markup.
intro: Writes the HTML and CSS for a skip link, checks its contrast and explains how to test it.
why:
A skip link lets keyboard users bypass repeated navigation (WCAG 2.4.1).

The generated link is the first focusable element, hidden by a transform rather than display none so it stays in the tab order, and revealed on focus with a visible outline. The tool checks text and outline contrast for the colours you pick and shows the main element markup.
howTo: Set the target id and text.
Test by pressing Tab then Enter.

faq.a: No, so there is nothing to turn off for reduced motion.
